Texas Fast Pool Inc, founded in Wylie, Texas by Susan and Todd Cranford, is a family-operated, full-service pool company. Utilizing Todd’s extensive experience in the pool industry and his engineering background, the company has established a reputation for constructing luxurious custom pools with meticulous attention to detail. These pools are designed for durability, specifically considering the extreme temperature fluctuations and expansive clay soils of the DFW metroplex. Todd’s expertise extends across both Canada and the United States. Ready to Design Your Dream Pool? data.summary: The reviews show some authentic signals like specific details and varied dates, but the perfect 5.0 score with only 4 reviews, complete lack of any critical feedback, and some oddly phrased generic praise raise concerns about potential review manipulation or solicitation. The extremely low volume is also suspicious for a pool company.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no constructive feedback
Low review volume (4) for a pool company
One review uses generic praise ('Big Boss Of poor companies' is odd phrasing)
One review praises owners by name in a community-focused way, which can be a solicitation tactic
All reviews are positive with no mention of any issues, which is unusual for real service experiences
authentic_signals: One review mentions a specific technician (Miguel) and a specific task (replacing mastic)
Review dates are spread out (8 months, 10 months, a month ago)
Different author names and slight variations in writing style
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a perfect 5.0 rating. No other platforms have ratings for comparison.
